relationships.subject: pain catastrophizing
relationships.evidence_quote: On multivariable analysis, after controlling for age, BMI, urinary urgency, and bladder pain, pain catastrophizing score was negatively associated with BDNF (p=0.04) and VEGF levels (p=0.03) (Figure 1).

key_findings: In women with bladder pain syndrome, higher pain catastrophizing was associated with lower urinary BDNF and VEGF after multivariable adjustment.
Bladder pain was associated with higher urinary NGF and VEGF.
